name: Niedorp (Netherlands, 1970–1992)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over black, with a red lion at the hoist of the yellow stripe and a white sword with yellow hilt lying along the black stripe.
history: The first flag of the municipality of Niedorp, formed in 1970 from Nieuwe Niedorp, Oude Niedorp and Winkel, combining the lion and sword of the constituent villages. It was replaced on 16 December 1992; Niedorp merged into Hollands Kroon in 2012.
